headline: Public hearings on zoning variance requests for 5 Ridgewood Ter and 346 Maple St.
summary: Applicant Philip Burdick asks to build a taller detached garage in the front yard of a corner lot, which would also block the view of drivers. Applicant Dmytro Pershyn asks to change a single-family house at 346 Maple St into a two-family house.
items: Public hearing on continued variance petition for 5 Ridgewood Ter, applicant Philip Burdick, Residence A district
Request to build a detached garage in the front yard that is taller than allowed and blocks the view on a corner lot
Public hearing on continued variance petition for 346 Maple St, applicant Dmytro Pershyn, Residence A district
Request to change an existing single-family house into a two-family house in a Residence A district
plain_text:
ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS 
REGULARLY SCHEDULED MEETING 
 
 
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 18, 2026 
 
                                                                                                     Agenda 
                                                            
 
 
 
 
 
I. OPENING REMARKS & PROCEDURES (CHAIRPERSON) 
II. ACCEPTANCE OF MINUTES 
III. PUBLIC HEARING – VARIANCE PETITION (CONTINUANCE) 
a. Address:    5 Ridgewood Ter  
b. Property ID #:   101970038  
c. Applicant:   Philip Burdick  
d. Zoning District:   Residence “A”  
e. Applicable Provisions & Request:   A variation from the requirements of the 
Springfield Zoning Ordinance. “So as to be allowed to erect a detached garage in 
the front yard. that would also exceed the height for the detached structure and 
also would violate the regulations for a vision obstruction on a corner lot” that 
would be in violation of the Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 5 section 5.2.50 
and Article 5 section 5.2.70 and Article 5 Table 5-1 
IV. PUBLIC HEARING – VARIANCE PETITION (CONTINUANCE) 
a. Address:     346 Maple St  
b. Property ID #:   082180093  
c. Applicant:   DMYTRO   PERSHYN  
d. Zoning District:   Residence “A”  
e. Applicable Provisions & Request:  A variation from the requirements of the 
Springfield Zoning Ordinance. “So as to be allowed to Alter an existing single-
family house for use as  a two-family house in a residence A zoning district” that 
would be in violation of the Springfield Zoning Ordinance Article 4 Table 4-1
